title.en: Stop a run and read the log it leaves behind

goal.en: Stop always works. Start a run, stop it while it waits for a person, and read the ExecutionLog: what was done, by whom it was verified, and that it carries no personal data.

note.en: Start a shakshuka run with a person present.
Let the arm finish the three cutting steps; the run then waits for a person to heat the pan.
Stop with a reason. The hub answers at once with state stopping; the device cuts motion and heat locally.
The next tick of the simulated device completes the stop.
The run is now stopped, a final state.
The log exists once the run has ended. It records the three steps that ran, the device and its safety-limits pack, the outcome aborted_safe, and privacy fields that say no personal data is inside.

outcome.en: You know that a stop is answered immediately and that the log of an aborted run is as complete as the log of a served one. Next: scenario 058 looks at the privacy fields of the log.
